'''Muskmelon''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden vegetable]]. They can be planted in all seasons and the melon is edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] muskmelon vines for their ''fruit''.
